caption: The image shows an ornate, oval-shaped ceramic plate with a detailed monochrome design, primarily in shades of gray, indicative of a black-and-white photograph of a possibly blue and white or multi-colored original. The central scene features a pastoral landscape with a winding road or path, along which an oxen-drawn cart travels. To the right of the path are rocks and trees, including one prominent tree that leans towards the center. To the left, rolling terrain descends toward a river or lake, beyond which a town or settlement with numerous buildings, roofs, and a church spire is visible. In the middle ground is a bridge spanning the water, and in the distance, hills or mountains rise against a cloudy sky. The broad rim of the plate is decorated with intricate floral motifs, large flowers, leaves, and smaller foliage interspersed with scroll-like patterns and possibly birds or ribbons, all arranged symmetrically and encircling the central scene. The plate itself has a scalloped edge, emphasized by a repeating border pattern.
title: Plate - "Newburgh on the Hudson"
